gold.text: Users can add new job application entries, including company name, job title, and date.
Users can edit existing job application entries to update company name, job title, date, status, or notes.
Users can delete job application entries from the list.
Users can set or update the status of each application, with options including: applied, interviewed, or accepted.
Users can add or edit notes for each job application.
Users can view a list of all job applications and their details (company, position, date, status).
New job application entries cannot be added if the required fields (company name, job title, and date) are not provided.
Date fields must only accept valid date formats and reject invalid date inputs.
The status field can only accept predefined values: applied, interviewed, or hired.
If required fields are cleared or set to empty, edits to application entries cannot be saved.
After successfully adding a new job application, a confirmation message or visual feedback will be displayed.
After successfully editing a job application, a confirmation message or visual feedback will be displayed.
After successfully deleting a job application, a confirmation message or visual feedback will be displayed.
Provide a clear mechanism (button, icon, or menu) to trigger edit and delete operations for each application entry.
When attempting to submit a form with missing or invalid required fields, a validation error message is displayed.
All displayed job application data (company, position, date, status, remarks) must accurately reflect the information entered by the user.
The status label displayed in the list must exactly match one of the three allowed values: applied, interviewed, or offered.
